489-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Nylea, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-5776-7422-8249.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

767-3286-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-3286-4687.description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

222-527-4247-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2438-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5078-6089-6259.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Samut.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

206-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

261-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4331-4993-5116-5705.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker triggers, creating an Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

539-3301-3899-4552-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-4023-5315-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-4023-5315-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2350-3532-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

662-1526-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
662-1526-1978.description:
Cause Circle of Dreams Druid to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2267-2557-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-2557-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1778-2173-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature That Triggers on Being Tapped

1651-3263-5640--135.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and the creature with a tap trigger, targeting the creature.
Ertha Jo and the creature trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger.
Resolve the Ertha Jo trigger, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and the creature tapped in step 1.
Repeat.

2292-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

215-1322-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {3}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-1322-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

738-2034-2518-6134.description:
Cast Perilous Myr by paying {2}.
Rendmaw triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token with flying and that is goaded for the rest of the game.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Perilous Myr, adding {C}{C}.
When Perilous Myr dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to a Bird token an opponent controls, thus killing the Bird.
Glissa triggers, returning Perilous Myr from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

565-1594-1858--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1594-1858--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

224-433-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
If the land enters untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1356-4762-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid and creating a Food token.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, untapping it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

765-774-3875.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

874-3200-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
874-3200-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

4067-5796-5874.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
Sphinx of the Revelation does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {W} and a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
4067-5796-5874.description:
Activate Sphinx of the Revelation by paying {W}{U}{U}, tapping it and paying at least {E}{E}{E}{E}, causing you to draw at least four cards.
Starving Revenant triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Starving Revenant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Starving Revenant trigger.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx of the Revelation.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {W} or {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W} or {U}.
Repeat from step 7 until you have {W}{U}{U} available.
Repeat from step 1.
You may pay additional {E} if able to net near-infinite card draw.

147-3842-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one permanent card in your graveyard.
147-3842-5231.description:
Cast Planewide Celebration by paying {5}{G}{G}, choosing the first mode twice, the third mode once and any other desired mode.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Planewide Celebration.
Resolve the Planewide Celebration copy, creating two 2/2 Citizen creature tokens, then returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to your hand, then receiving the results of the remaining mode.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Citizens, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

678-5256-5553.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Greedy Freebooter's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1284-4067-5467.notablePrerequisites:
Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
Viridian Longbow attached to Wylie Duke.
1284-4067-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

814-1651-2034-2751.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-1651-2034-2751.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Soldiers, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

678-3771-4326.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least five +1/+1 counters.
678-3771-4326.description:
Cast Multiform Wonder by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Multiform Wonder enters the battlefield, causing you to gain {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Multiform Wonder's third ability twice by paying {E}{E}, giving Multiform Wonder +4/-4 until end of turn.
Multiform Wonder dies as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Multiform Wonder from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

541-2103-3632-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
In response, activate Erratic Portal by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1228-3056.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-3056.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter targeting a creature an opponent controls.
That creature triggers, causing its controller to sacrifice it.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2034-3821-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{B}.
2034-3821-5140.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

364-1964-1987-3227.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
